Discover why builders and a homeowner chose Dacor for Aripeka, a luxury single-family community in Viera, Florida.

This case study explores how Dacor luxury built-in appliances help builders create distinctive homes while bringing convenience and sophistication to everyday living.

From refrigeration and wine preservation to cooking and dishwashing, see how seamless integration with cabinetry, precision performance and smart connectivity enhance the kitchen experience.
